Hi Tessa,

Thanks again for the quick follow-up. We're excited by Redwood's approach and would like to get a pilot scheduled, but a heads up: finance has flagged a potential spend freeze as they re-run FY allocations this week. Our CFO is OOO for the next ten days and procurement has put most new POs into a pending state until the FY gate is reconfirmed.

Would you still be able to do a product walkthrough next week? If it looks like we need to pause, we can aim for a short exec briefing instead to keep momentum. I'll loop in procurement for next steps.

Best,
Ellen
Director, Digital Platforms
Stratus Health

Hi Ellen — thanks for the note and the RFP doc. Totally understand the FY gating risk. We're flexible on format: a 45-minute technical walkthrough with Karthik + a short 20-minute executive briefing for your leadership both work. 

If finance is pausing POs, we can:
- Run the technical demo now (internal team only) to validate integration surface area, or
- Do a 20-minute exec briefing to keep sponsorship warm and agree a follow-up date after the gate clears.

Provisional slots (PT):
- Thu 11/19 10:00–10:45
- Fri 11/20 14:00–14:45
- Mon 11/23 09:00–09:45 (if that helps with cross-timezone folks)

I'm attaching a plain-SOW so procurement can see the order shape; no signature required yet. If you prefer, we can carve out a short discovery session first.

Attachments: SOW-draft-v2.pdf (summary), PO-template.xlsx (procurement sample)

Let me know which path you'd prefer and I'll lock resources.

—Tessa

- Karthik: prepare 2–3 quick bullets on integration risk and expected effort (to reassure SRE/infra).
- Laura: send the SOW-draft and PO template to procurement (procurement@stratushealth.com) so they can queue paperwork internally.

No need to ship the full technical demo until the gate clears; keep the deep-dive as a ‘post-gate’ milestone. We should offer three provisional walkthrough windows in the first week after 11/29 to minimize calendar churn (I'll propose Fri 11/30 11:00, Mon 12/3 10:00, Tue 12/4 15:00 PT).

- Marissa: confirm availability to lead the exec brief (20–25 mins) andI'll draft the slide deck outline.
- Karthik: two bullets by EOD Monday 11/23.
- Laura: send SOW/PO to procurement with cc to Ellen.

We'll label the HubSpot deal as "On Hold — FY Gate" and note the post-gate provisional slots. Linking the HubSpot record here: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/SH-2026-1123

Thanks — short and pragmatic here to avoid losing momentum.

—Tessa
